book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
author: Galen Woods

strategies.name: wide_bull_inside_bar_breakout
strategies.description: Buy the upside break of a wide-range (>75% of prior bar range) bullish inside bar while the 20 EMA slopes up; 1:1 target as in the book's backtest.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
source.quote: We focused on wide range inside bars that closed in the direction of our trade

decisions: Backtest was ES 5m futures; mapped to 5m/15m/1h crypto.
'Slope of 20-period EMA as trend filter' = ema(20) > ema(20) one bar ago.
Entry is a buy stop one tick above the inside bar high; modelled as high > high[1] on the next bar (fill at inside-bar high assumed by engine; if engine fills at close, entry is late).
Stop at the inside bar low (lowest_low of the previous 1 bar = inside bar), the usual pattern stop.
Target 1R exactly as in the book's test; time stop 24 bars added (book gives none).
Book gives no risk percentage; 0.5% chosen.
uncodable: Short side (bearish inside bar closing down, break below, falling EMA) not codable long-only.
Regular-trading-session restriction has no crypto equivalent.

strategies.name: sma20_shallow_pullback_trend_confirm
strategies.description: Woods' MA+price-action bull-trend confirmation: price touches the 20 SMA, holds above it on a shallow pullback, then breaks the last extreme high; enter on that confirmation and trail with the SMA.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
source.quote: Bull trend confirmed when price rises above the last extreme high.

decisions: 'Price touches the MA' = some bar's low <= SMA(20) within the last 20 bars.
'No bar high below the MA during the pullback' approximated by >=3 consecutive closes above SMA(20) and the current low above it (cannot test every bar's high directly).
'Last extreme high' approximated as highest high of the previous 10 bars.
The book uses this as a trend definition, not a full setup; stop below the last 5-bar low and SMA trailing exit (book p. 51 suggests MA trailing stops) are our additions.
Book gives no risk percentage; 0.5% chosen.
uncodable: Bear-trend version (short) not codable.
Session-open gap context.
Not coded yet: all_bars_high_above(sma(20), lookback since touch) — condition that holds for every bar in a window
Not coded yet: swing_high_pivot (last extreme high) instead of fixed 10-bar highest high

strategies.name: price_channel_two_bars_above
strategies.description: Bernstein-style moving-average channel: go long when two consecutive bars sit completely above the channel (bull trend defined); exit when a bar is completely below it.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
source.quote: When two price bars stay completely above the channel, we define a bull trend.

decisions: Book's channel = moving averages of bar highs and bar lows, period not given. Grammar has no SMA of highs/lows; approximated with a 1-std Bollinger band (book says Bollinger/Keltner bands may be used with adapted rules). This is an approximation.
Period 20 chosen for consistency with the book's other 20-period tools.
Third condition makes it fire only on the first two-bar confirmation.
Exit when a bar is completely below the lower band (book: two bars below = bear trend; one bar used for faster exit). Stop below 3-bar low is our addition.
Book gives no risk percentage; 0.5% chosen.
uncodable: Bear-trend (short) version.
Coded by hand as a built-in strategy (strategies/price_action.py)

strategies.name: ema20_pullback_two_bar_reversal
strategies.description: In a bullish context (price above a rising 20 EMA), buy a pullback that touches the 20 EMA and reverses with a two-bar reversal; modest target and EMA trailing exit.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
source.quote: In a bull trend, buy when prices retrace to the 20-period moving average.

decisions: Book uses an EMA (SMA also fine); EMA(20).
'Bull trend/bullish context' = EMA slope positive over 5 bars and price was above the EMA 3 bars ago (book's context questions are discretionary).
'Two-bar reversal' = a down bar followed by an up bar closing above the down bar's high.
'Retrace to the MA' = low touched EMA(20) in the last 2 bars.
Stop below the two-bar pattern low; target 1.5R because the book says aim for nearer targets in a non-strong trend; EMA trailing exit per p. 51.
Book gives no risk percentage; 0.5% chosen.
uncodable: Short pullbacks in bear trends.
Discretionary context reading (MA overlap count, slope flips).
Not coded yet: two_bar_reversal (exact pattern feature; current version is an approximation)

strategies.name: pin_bar_reentry_long
strategies.description: Skip the original bullish pin bar trade; after its buyers are stopped below the pin low, buy the break above a bullish bar while above the 20 EMA.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
source.quote: Look to buy when price breaks above any bullish bar

decisions: Pin bar approximated by the grammar's hammer feature.
'Market falls below the pin low' approximated by a fresh 10-bar low within the last 6 bars (pin bars usually mark the local low); ordering pin -> trigger -> stop-out cannot be enforced.
'Breaks above any bullish bar' = previous bar is up, current close above its high.
Close above EMA(20) added: book's losing example re-entered below the EMA and the author flags that as the difference.
Book gives no stop/target for the re-entry; stop below the 6-bar low (re-entry swing low), target 2R, time stop 30 bars are our choices.
Examples were 30m/1h forex futures; mapped to 15m-1h.
Book gives no risk percentage; 0.5% chosen.
uncodable: Short re-entry (bearish pin) version.
Skipping setups after a projected chart-pattern target was hit.
Coded by hand as a built-in strategy (strategies/price_action.py)

strategies.name: nr7_bull_pullback_trigger
strategies.description: In an uptrend, a pullback ending in an NR7 bar outside tight congestion; buy the break above the NR7 high with a stop under its low.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
source.quote: A bullish pullback ended with a NR7 bar.

decisions: Bullish context = rising EMA(20) over 5 bars; pullback = NR7 bar close below the close 3 bars earlier but still above EMA(50).
'Not within tight congestion' = 20-bar range before the NR7 exceeds 3 ATR (threshold chosen; book gives none).
Entry on break above NR7 high (stop-order style); stop below the NR7 bar low.
Book's target is the last extreme high; approximated as 2R.
Book gives no risk percentage; 0.5% chosen.
uncodable: Short-side NR7 setups.
Intraday volatility-pattern (time-of-day) filter.
Not coded yet: target_at_last_swing_high (structural target)
Not coded yet: congestion filter: no higher close for >=3 consecutive bars (book's definition)

strategies.name: hikkake_inside_bar_false_breakdown_long
strategies.description: Hikkake long: an inside bar's downside breakout fails and price reverses up through the inside bar high, trading against the trapped breakout sellers.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Master Edition
source.quote: It waits for a breakout of an inside bar to fail.

decisions: Book describes Hikkake only conceptually (details in another edition); the standard two-bar failure window is used: inside bar, next bar breaks its low without breaking its high, then close above the inside bar high.
Rising EMA(20) filter added to keep with-trend, per the book's trend emphasis.
Stop below the false-breakdown low; target 2R; both our choices.
Book gives no risk percentage; 0.5% chosen.
uncodable: Bearish Hikkake (short).
Not coded yet: hikkake pattern with variable confirmation window (up to 3 bars after the false break)
